data.title: Release 0.8.1: everything since 0.8.0, and provenance npm can read
data.description: Publish kadence@0.8.1 (compatibility suite, report flow --by-status and burnup, doc edit in $EDITOR, note show, doc sections, stale docs, stemmed search and --also, hooks for Codex, Cursor and Copilot) through the tag-triggered release workflow and verify it from the registry. 0.8.0's provenance page says 'Unable to fetch the source commit': npm got a 408 from GitHub once and cached it, so a fresh publish is also a fresh check.
